improvements_suggested: Add an experiment-scoped compute launch watchdog that samples GPU utilization, fails fast when a compute-bound task remains idle across a bounded launch window, and reclaims stale task-owned allocations before retry.
Record monotonic sub-minute spans for setup, model loading, inference, and teardown so the duration leader has a causal timing breakdown.
Emit model-count and runner-choice receipts at dispatch, requiring DualGPURunner only when multiple models are loaded in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Gate compute-bound launches on a task-scoped GPU heartbeat and fail fast on sustained zero utilization.
Add sub-minute phase timing to every experiment artifact.
Persist model-count and runner-selection receipts for every compute dispatch.
meta_reflection: The fallback timing is sufficient to rank the four entries but not to explain the duration leader's cost. The GPU snapshot supports the required idle flag, while parallel multi-model runner coverage has no data available this milestone.
